Which emoji carry these keywords?

Source: R/emoji-catalogue.R
emoji_find.Rd

emoji_find() returns the emoji whose CLDR keyword set contains any (or all) of the given terms: "which emoji mean celebration?" in one call. It is the inverse of emoji_keywords(), and the way to assemble a stimulus set by semantic field.

Usage

emoji_find(terms, match = c("any", "all"))

Arguments

terms

A character vector of keywords to look for. Terms that differ only in case are one term, reported in the spelling given first. An empty vector finds nothing; NA and "" are errors.

match

"any" (default) to return emoji carrying at least one of the terms, "all" for emoji carrying every one of them.

Value

A tibble with one row per emoji found, under its canonical spelling: emoji, name, group, matched (the terms it carries, joined with ", ", in the order given) and n_matched. Rows are sorted by descending n_matched, then in catalogue order. No match gives a typed zero-row tibble.

Details

A term matches a keyword exactly, ignoring case, so "celebration" finds the party popper and "celebrat" finds nothing; emoji_search() is the substring search, over names and shortcodes as well as keywords. The fold to lower case does not depend on the session's locale.

English only. The keyword sets are English ones, the emoji package's and CLDR 49's together (see emoji_keywords()), so a term in another language matches nothing and an English term says nothing about how the emoji is read elsewhere. Every emoji in the catalogue has keywords, the newest included.

See also

emoji_keywords(), emoji_search().

Examples

emoji_find("celebration")
#> # A tibble: 47 × 5
#>    emoji name                                  group           matched n_matched
#>    <chr> <chr>                                 <chr>           <chr>       <int>
#>  1 🥳    partying face                         Smileys & Emot… celebr…         1
#>  2 🙌    raising hands                         People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  3 🙌🏻    raising hands: light skin tone        People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  4 🙌🏼    raising hands: medium-light skin tone People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  5 🙌🏽    raising hands: medium skin tone       People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  6 🙌🏾    raising hands: medium-dark skin tone  People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  7 🙌🏿    raising hands: dark skin tone         People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  8 🎅    Santa Claus                           People & Body   celebr…         1
#>  9 🎅🏻    Santa Claus: light skin tone          People & Body   celebr…         1
#> 10 🎅🏼    Santa Claus: medium-light skin tone   People & Body   celebr…         1
#> # ℹ 37 more rows
emoji_find(c("cat", "face"), match = "all")
#> # A tibble: 11 × 5
#>    emoji name                           group             matched   n_matched
#>    <chr> <chr>                          <chr>             <chr>         <int>
#>  1 😺    grinning cat                   Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  2 😸    grinning cat with smiling eyes Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  3 😹    cat with tears of joy          Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  4 😻    smiling cat with heart-eyes    Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  5 😼    cat with wry smile             Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  6 😽    kissing cat                    Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  7 🙀    weary cat                      Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  8 😿    crying cat                     Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#>  9 😾    pouting cat                    Smileys & Emotion cat, face         2
#> 10 🐱    cat face                       Animals & Nature  cat, face         2
#> 11 🐯    tiger face                     Animals & Nature  cat, face         2
